notes: CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5808, PB5885, PB5890 LANDED). Every statement bound in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure is asked, in BindStatement, whether the emitter-verified store classification (BoundStores.StoresInto) stores into a storage-related item of any report's control data item: SameStorageLine is the item, a group containing it, an item subordinate to it, or an item that shares a byte with it through a REDEFINES or RENAMES (the layout's StorageExtent overlap, the same relation ReportSectionBinder.ControlDataReferenceOf asks of SR5 of the 1985 SOURCE rule; a table is every occurrence; an unprovable extent is not asked). The classification counts the stores an input-output statement makes through its file connector without naming the item (kb/Work PB5885; PlaceBuilder.ConnectorStores places them): READ and RETURN into the record area of every record description of the file and of a SAME RECORD AREA file and into the DEPENDING ON item, READ into the RELATIVE KEY item, CLOSE, DELETE, OPEN, READ, REWRITE, START, UNLOCK and WRITE into the FILE STATUS item, a sequential-access relative WRITE into the RELATIVE KEY item, and the implicit READ and WRITE of SORT and MERGE USING and GIVING. A statement that stores into SELECTED items of the group it names is asked for those items, not for the group (kb/Work PB5890; the classification's StoreView.Storage): MOVE, ADD and SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING for the receiving item of each corresponding pair, INITIALIZE for the elementary stores of its expansion after its category selection, exclusions and default, so INITIALIZE G REPLACING NUMERIC DATA and a CORRESPONDING statement with no pair at the control data item of G are accepted, and a pair at it, a plain INITIALIZE G and a MOVE to G are refused. COBOL2378, one diagnostic per store, citing the edition's own rule. A BY REFERENCE CALL argument / INVOKE write-back is not counted: whether the callee alters it is not decidable from the source element.
